_about: People page data. Public fields: name, roles, years, line. Internal (never rendered): source, confidence, notes_internal, and any record with "publish": false. LL-7: names, band roles, years and band-era photos only; no quotes; nothing about anyone's life outside the band. LL-33 (operations, not copy): on Wikidata, MusicBrainz and Discogs, Chad, Scott and Larry are listed as members by name only, with no profile entries of their own.

forever_members.name: David Dewese
forever_members.line: Co-founded the band with Chad in 1997 and carried it on as a trio from 2001.
forever_members.source: daviddewese.com DECISIONS F4, P8, P21; 2005 roster (research/01 §3.2); DECISIONS-2026-10-07.md LL-9

forever_members.name: Chad Edgington
forever_members.line: Co-founded the band with David in 1997 and left Nashville in March 2001. He is in the band again today, and he plays on “Great Day” and “New Beginning”, which he wrote with David.
forever_members.source: daviddewese.com DECISIONS F4, P8; DECISIONS-2026-10-07.md LL-9 (in the band again now), LL-14, LL-15; plan §4.3 row "Who is in the band now"; 2005 roster
forever_members.notes_internal: When Chad rejoined is an open question (plan §4.3); the copy does not date it. JSON-LD keeps endDate 2001 for his first stint (plan §8.2).

forever_members.name: Scott Carpenter
forever_members.line: Joined on drums in August 1998, and plays on every Luxury Liners album and single from *Sound As Ever* on.
forever_members.source: daviddewese.com DECISIONS P8; 2005 roster; DECISIONS-2026-10-07.md LL-18 (joined August 1998), LL-9 (in the band today); plays on every album and single from Sound As Ever on (data/releases.json personnel); the line deliberately does not cover Nashpop (1998), Antarctic Antics (2001) or the SESAC promo, where his part is unknown

forever_members.name: David “Larry” Wilstermann
forever_members.line: Joined on bass in December 2000. The band already had a David, so he became Larry.
forever_members.source: daviddewese.com DECISIONS P8; 2005 roster; Nonetheless credits (research/01 §3.2)
